description: This file contains utility functions and configuration variables used in the TensorFlow project's CI build process. It includes functions for retrying commands, installing dependencies, setting up environments, handling wheels, and report generation. It is not a typical programming language source file but a shell script used for build automation.

methods.name: run_with_retry
methods.description: Executes a command and retries once if it fails, with a 60 second delay.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: readable_run
methods.description: Runs a command and prints logs only if the command fails; on success, logs command completion.

methods.name: set_bazel_outdir
methods.description: Sets up the environment variable for the Bazel output directory.

methods.name: install_bazelisk
methods.description: Downloads and installs Bazelisk to manage Bazel versions.

methods.name: update_bazel_linux
methods.description: Installs a specific Bazel version on Linux.

methods.name: install_ubuntu_16_pip_deps
methods.description: Installs Python dependencies for Ubuntu 16, including upgrading pip and uninstalling conflicting packages.

methods.name: install_ubuntu_16_python_pip_deps
methods.description: Similar to above but supports different pip invocation methods.

methods.name: install_ubuntu_pip_deps
methods.description: Installs pip dependencies for Ubuntu, including requirements specified in a project file.

methods.name: setup_venv_ubuntu
methods.description: Creates and activates a Python virtual environment, then installs dependencies.

methods.name: remove_venv_ubuntu
methods.description: Deactivates and removes the Python virtual environment.

methods.name: install_ubuntu_pip_deps_novenv
methods.description: Installs dependencies in the system Python environment without virtualenv.

methods.name: upload_wheel_cpu_ubuntu
methods.description: Repairs, tests, and uploads CPU wheels to PyPI.

methods.name: upload_wheel_gpu_ubuntu
methods.description: Repairs, tests, and uploads GPU wheels to PyPI.

methods.name: install_macos_pip_deps
methods.description: Installs dependencies on macOS, including uninstalling conflicting packages.

methods.name: install_macos_pip_deps_no_venv
methods.description: Installs dependencies on macOS without virtualenv.

methods.name: setup_venv_macos
methods.description: Creates and activates a virtual environment on macOS, then installs dependencies.

methods.name: activate_venv_macos
methods.description: Activates macOS virtual environment.

methods.name: setup_python_from_pyenv_macos
methods.description: Sets up Python environment on macOS using pyenv.

methods.name: maybe_skip_v1
methods.description: Determines whether to skip v1 tests based on build configuration.

methods.name: copy_to_new_project_name
methods.description: Copies and renames a wheel file to a new project name.

methods.name: test_xml_summary
methods.description: Generates a summary XML report for build/test results.

methods.name: test_xml_summary_exit
methods.description: Generates a summary report and exits with the last command's status.

methods.name: test_tf_whl_size
methods.description: Checks wheel file sizes against predefined limits to ensure they don't exceed CDN thresholds.
